quarterly_data.signal: ArcelorMittal 6-K: after four missile strikes in five weeks (five deaths, 17 injured), ArcelorMittal advised the Government of Ukraine that it is unable to restart operations at ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih in a safe and sustainable manner and will focus on preserving the infrastructure; it expects a non-cash impairment charge of approximately US$1 billion, principally on Kryvyi Rih property, plant and equipment, having provided over US$700 million of support to the subsidiary since the war began.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately US$1 billion non-cash impairment expected
